says: `pnpm lint` fails on main because tracked-scripts.ts still lists scripts/typecheck.sh on NOT_YET_PORTED after the ticket 766 pull request removed that script from git.
proof: `node oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts` prints "scripts/typecheck.sh is on NOT_YET_PORTED, and git does not track it: delete its line in oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts, since the list only shrinks." and exits 1; `git ls-tree origin/main scripts/typecheck.sh` prints nothing at 4909b55df, and oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts:35 still reads "scripts/typecheck.sh".
cost: Every branch's local `pnpm lint` fails on a part its change did not touch, so a real lint failure can hide behind it.
